title: Anyone got HTML games you'd like to get people to play?
author: ArkadeHyve
selftext:
I built a gaming social media site that has a MMO game wrapped around the whole thing called Bee Keepers (Train and duel with Ai Mech Bees). Anyways, part of the game loop is I'm attaching achievement lists to all my HTML games that will drop loot boxes in users mail box once they hit whatever the achievement is. I wanted to give indie devs a fun place to show off their stuff. You can also upload your games directly to your profile to showcase what you're making. If anyone is interested just shoot me a message or send a submission

I've gotten most the game set up around the site. Working on the Ai combat is the hard part.

comments.author: ibuildtools
comments.body:
Ecophene: a creature survival game that runs in your browser. No install, no account.  
https://ecophene.vercel.app/

You hatch tiny on a 3 km² island and try to survive one life. There are almost no on-screen markers. The edges of your screen glow toward what you sense: water, food, prey, and predators watching you. Stay alive long enough to nest, spend what that life earned on adaptations for your young, then hatch as one of them. If you die first, a clutch-mate carries on, but your line only gains new traits by nesting.

There are 20 species (ground, water and air) and 134 adaptations. The creature voices are real animal recordings, pitched and filtered. It's Three.js and TypeScript, built with Claude Code.

It's for desktop with mouse and keyboard. Balance is still rough, so I'd love to hear what killed you and whether you wanted another life.
